lines.text: The Philistines took the captured ark from Ebenezer to Ashdod and set it beside Dagon's statue.
Ashdod's people found Dagon fallen before the ark twice, and the second time his head and hands were broken off.
The LORD's hand afflicted Ashdod with locusts, so its men asked the Philistine rulers what to do with the ark.
The LORD's hand was against Gath too, and the ark was then sent to Ekron, where the people cried out.
The Ekronites asked the priests to send the ark away, and the city's outcry went up to heaven.
